decision: Do not deduplicate and do not start the full collection. The reviewed official POWER materials do not expose an authoritative pre-request grid-cell identifier, grid origin/indexing rule, or parameter-complete point-to-cell mapping for these four parameters.

evidence.finding: The Daily API warns that a 0.5 degree by 0.5 degree catalog needs one request per cell, but it does not define a point-to-cell snapping/indexing algorithm or return a cell ID.
POWER says Release 9 meteorological inputs use 0.5 degree latitude by 0.625 degree longitude spatial resolution and that products retain input-data resolutions.
The four requested variables are meteorological products associated with MERRA-2/GEOS, but common source family/resolution alone does not establish the API's point-to-cell mapping.
POWER Daily API v2.10.3 defines Geometry.coordinates as a generic array and documents no grid-cell identifier, grid index, coordinate meaning, or equivalence field.

All four smoke responses identify API v2.10.3 and sources MERRA2/POWER. Their geometry coordinates are rounded forms of the submitted district points plus elevation; this field is preserved as response metadata and is not treated as a documented grid key.

prohibited_inferences: Do not group points by proximity or locally rounded latitude/longitude.
Do not group responses because observed weather values happen to match.
Do not construct or label a NASA grid-cell ID.
Do not assume all parameters share a request-equivalence mapping from resolution alone.
resolution_condition: Full execution may proceed only after official POWER evidence supplies an authoritative mapping or equivalence key covering PRECTOTCORR, T2M, T2M_MIN and T2M_MAX, and the checked-in decision and district-to-request mapping are independently reviewed and updated.
